prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Dallas for a truck accident case?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” lawyer for every truck accident — the right attorney depends on the facts of your case, the lawyer’s experience with commercial trucking, and how well you and the lawyer work together. I can help you find highly qualified Dallas truck-accident attorneys, but first here are practical steps and criteria to use when choosing one.

How to pick the best Dallas truck-accident lawyer for your case
- Look for specific truck/CMV experience: truck cases require knowledge of Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration (FMCSA) rules, electronic logging devices (ELDs), driver/vehicle inspections, and commercial insurance. Make sure the lawyer has handled multiple truck collisions.
- Trial experience: many carriers refuse fair settlements. Prefer lawyers who actually try cases in court and have trial verdicts in truck cases.
- Board certification or recognition: Texas Board of Legal Specialization certification in Personal Injury Trial Law is a strong plus; also check Super Lawyers, Martindale‑Hubbell peer ratings, and local trial lawyer awards.
- Resources and team: truck cases can require accident reconstruction, forensic ELD analysis, and medical experts — ensure the firm has or funds these specialists.
- Communication and accessibility: you should get timely updates and a clear fee arrangement (usually contingency fee for personal injury).
- Track record: look for settlements/verdicts in truck cases (ideally similar injuries/facts to yours).

Questions to ask at a free consultation
- How many truck/large commercial vehicle cases have you handled? How many went to trial?
- Do you have experience with FMCSA regulations and ELD/data downloads?
- Who will handle my case day-to-day (partner, associate)?
- What experts would you use (reconstructionist, ELD analyst, treating physicians)?
- What is your fee and what costs will I be responsible for if we lose?
- Can you provide references or past case results?

Where to find and check Dallas attorneys
- Dallas Bar Association lawyer referral service
- Dallas Trial Lawyers Association
- Texas State Bar (verify license, disciplinary record)
- Legal directories: Super Lawyers, Martindale‑Hubbell, Avvo/Justia (look for client reviews and peer ratings)

Red flags to avoid
- No experience with truck/carrier cases or no trial record
- Guarantees of a specific settlement amount
- Poor communication or evasive answers about fees or strategy
- Requires large upfront fee (most work on contingency)

What to do now (if this just happened)
- Seek medical attention immediately and follow doctors’ instructions.
- Preserve evidence: photos of vehicles/scene, witness names/contacts, police report number.
- Don’t post details or photos on social media.
- Preserve truck data if possible (ELD, dashcam) — tell a lawyer quickly so they can issue preservation letters.
- Contact insurance but avoid giving recorded statements without your attorney.

If you want, I can:
- Provide a short list of well-rated Dallas truck-accident attorneys and firms (I’ll need your preferred Dallas area or zip code and whether you want large firm vs. smaller boutique).
- Draft a list of questions to bring to consultations.
Tell me which you prefer and any case details you’re comfortable sharing (date/location of crash, injuries, whether truck driver/owner was identified).
